properties.name: -webkit-mask
properties.values: url(...) | none; supported mask mode, position, size, repeat, origin, clip, and composite values
properties.note: The shorthand expands its supported subset and resets mask-border values. CSS gradients, image-set, mask-border painting, and an in-repo pixel replay backend are unsupported.

properties.name: -webkit-mask-clip
properties.note: Values are emitted in element-group metadata for the display-list consumer. Blinkless has no pixel replay backend, so it does not apply these mask layers to a rendered page.
